title: List flows and documents
summary: Use the list APIs to retrieve flows, group documents, and document types.
purpose: Use the list APIs to retrieve flows, group documents, and document types.
request: {{route:list.groups}}, {{route:list.group}}, {{route:list.group_documents}}, or {{route:list.doc_types}} for project flows, group details, group documents, or document types respectively.
response: The list APIs return live data. Group details include the name, module, status, dates, and document count.
errors: For `404` on a missing or unreadable target, check project and group identifiers and read permissions.
